Detailed Description

This class implements MIPI Dual DSI System Monitor component. DSI Dual Monitor gets split packets from DSI Monitors. Each split packet is processed and combined to create a single dsi packet. DSI Dual Monitor also, performs checks on single packets to check errors in packet field.

DSI Dual Monitor can be used in active and passive mode. In active mode, DSI Dual Monitor can be disable using the configuration. But, in passive mode, DSI Dual Monitor shall always enable.

Analysis ports are given for users to get single packets out of the Dual DSI Monitor.

Member Attribute Documentation

 uvm_analysis_port  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor::single_pkt_observed_port

Single packet TLM Analysis ports for DSI Dual Monitor.

Provides a mechanism for retrieving single combined packet. The handle to the single packet TLM analysis port can be set or obtained through the monitor's public member single_pkt_observed_port. Used in passive or active mode.
